core_message: A premium edit uses one post-cut clock for every timed layer.
promise: The viewer will see why caption and graphic drift begins before rendering.
proof_strategy: Show the same cut with pre-cut timestamps and retimed post-cut timestamps.
payoff: A simple one-clock diagram resolves the problem and gives the viewer an actionable rule.

hook_hypothesis.claim: Your captions are not drifting because of the caption renderer.
hook_hypothesis.viewer_question: Then where does the drift come from?
hook_hypothesis.expected_behavior: The viewer stays to see the hidden timing failure.

emotional_curve.reason: The opening contradicts the expected diagnosis.
The side-by-side proof reveals how every timed layer can drift.
The one-clock rule gives a memorable solution.

open_loop_ledger.question: What actually causes caption and graphic drift?
open_loop_ledger.stakes: Without the answer, the viewer keeps fixing the wrong layer.

scenes.primary_job: Break the viewer's assumed diagnosis and open the core question.

viewer_state.exit_knowledge: The caption renderer may not be the cause.

scenes.information_or_emotion_delivered: A precise contradiction creates useful tension.

visual_role.purpose: Use direct eye contact to make the contradiction feel personal.
visual_role.composition: Tight centered crop with clean negative space above captions.

caption_role.purpose: Preserve the full contrast without fragmenting it into single words.

graphic_role.purpose: Emphasize the words NOT THE RENDERER once.

audio_role.music: Low pulse begins after the first clause.
audio_role.sound_effects: One restrained impact on the contradiction.
audio_role.silence_intent: A 120 ms pre-roll creates a clean start.

timing.duration_rationale: Enough time to land one contradiction and the resulting question.

failure_conditions: The opening names the solution before establishing the misconception.
Animation competes with the first sentence.

scenes.primary_job: Demonstrate that pre-cut timestamps diverge after cleanup cuts.

viewer_state.entering_question: If rendering is not the cause, what is?
viewer_state.exit_knowledge: Pre-cut timing becomes invalid after the EDL changes duration.

scenes.information_or_emotion_delivered: A visible before-and-after timeline makes the causal chain undeniable.

proof.description: Compare the same word cue on source and post-cut clocks.
proof.on_screen_evidence: Split-screen timeline with the cue visibly late in the pre-cut version.

visual_role.purpose: Show causality, not decorate the explanation.
visual_role.composition: Two synchronized horizontal clocks with one highlighted word cue.

caption_role.purpose: Keep the spoken explanation readable while the diagram carries the comparison.

audio_role.music: Pulse rises slightly under the mismatch.
audio_role.sound_effects: Soft tick at each clock marker.

timing.duration_rationale: The comparison needs time for the viewer to inspect both clocks.

failure_conditions: The diagram cannot be understood without pausing.
The proof uses a different cut than the narrated example.

scenes.primary_job: Resolve the loop with a durable one-clock production rule.

viewer_state.entering_question: How do I prevent the drift?
viewer_state.exit_knowledge: All timed layers must derive from retimed post-cut words.

scenes.information_or_emotion_delivered: A compact rule converts diagnosis into action.

proof.description: Show captions and graphics aligned to the retimed_words artifact.
proof.on_screen_evidence: One post-cut clock fans out to captions, graphics, audio cues, and review.

visual_role.purpose: Compress the final system into one memorable visual.
visual_role.composition: Single central clock with four calm outbound branches.

caption_role.purpose: Land ONE POST-CUT CLOCK as the takeaway.

graphic_role.purpose: Show the clock as the source of truth for downstream timing.

audio_role.dialogue: Final rule is delivered slowly and cleanly.
audio_role.silence_intent: Leave 300 ms after the final rule.

timing.duration_rationale: The system graphic needs a deliberate reveal and readable final hold.

failure_conditions: The viewer leaves without knowing which artifact owns time.
The CTA arrives before the visual system resolves.

ending_behavior.intended_aftertaste: The workflow feels simpler and controllable.
ending_behavior.viewer_next_action: Save the reel and use retimed post-cut words on the next edit.
